name: iqrow-skills
description: iqrow's agent skills. teardown takes a whole subject apart the way its professionals see it, as an interactive 3D exploded view to browse. teardown-lookup, teardown-apply and teardown-audit use that map on your own project: find what a problem is called and its prior art, apply one part, or audit the whole project into a strategy. teardown-upload offers a finished map to Teardown Atlas as a pull request.
